Create a NEW 15-second Japanese action-comedy with synchronized dialogue and sound effects. Use the selected aspect ratio.

STORY
A buys ONE soda. The vending machine suddenly pours out hundreds of cans. A and B flee, but the rolling avalanche catches and buries them up to their shoulders. B calmly opens one can. End on A's familiar stunned face, holding the single can she bought.
REFERENCES
A = the black-haired character from @Image 1; voice timbre from @Audio 1.
B = the white-haired character from @Image 2; voice timbre from @Audio 2.
Preserve exact faces, hairstyles, costumes, accessories, proportions and reference art styles. References define identity and voice, not poses, backgrounds or scripts. Never merge identities or replay recorded words.

SCENE AND STYLE
Deserted sidewalk beside Shibuya Scramble Crossing at dusk. One human-scale vending machine stands screen-right, its lower retrieval opening facing camera. A stands beside it; B waits to her left. Payment is already complete.
Photorealistic Shibuya architecture, crossing stripes, pavement, machine, cans and lighting. A and B remain hand-drawn 2D anime with clean lines and cel shading, integrated with contact shadows and reflected light.
Rows of plain drink cans and selection buttons; no readable labels or logos.
PROP AND ACTION CONTINUITY
All cans are hand-sized metal cylinders, silver with a cyan band and pull tab. No liquid flood, foam, giant cans or shapeless metallic mass.
Every new can emerges from the SAME retrieval opening. The machine keeps its size and design.
Cans shoot out in a narrow stream, fan outward, bounce and roll into a ground-level avalanche that catches the pair.
A receives the FIRST can in her RIGHT hand and keeps that same unopened can through the final frame. She never presses the button a second time.
Only TWO characters; BOTH are caught. Keep their faces visible and bodies uninjured. Retain the settled pile around them between shots.
0.0-2.0s — JUST ONE DRINK
Open on a medium two-shot showing both characters, the selection button and the retrieval opening.
A presses ONE button with her left hand. At 0.2-1.1s, A says in Japanese {いっぽんだけ。}, voice timbre referencing @Audio 1, with natural synchronized lips.
One can drops into the tray with an ordinary clunk. A picks it up with her right hand. B watches casually.
Finish the purchase by 2.0s; no walk-up or coin insertion.
(Light, brief instrumental everyday music.)
<Button click, one ordinary can clunk.>
2.0-4.5s — THE MACHINE WILL NOT STOP
Hold a clear three-quarter view including the machine, both characters and the ground.
Immediately after A takes her can, another drops, then several more. The clunks accelerate into a rapid mechanical rattle.
By approximately 2.8s, a continuous stream of cans bursts from the retrieval opening. It fans outward and becomes a rolling avalanche across the pavement.
The machine shudders but stays upright. A and B both react visibly: eyes widen, shoulders recoil, then they turn to flee.
Show the normal output turning into the avalanche without a concealing cut or smoke.
(The music cuts off when the rapid stream begins.)
<Accelerating metallic clunks, mechanical rattle, cascading cans.>

4.5-8.5s — RUNNING MAKES NO DIFFERENCE
Side tracking shot. Both characters run screen-left along the same sidewalk, away from the machine. A still grips her original can in her right hand.
The rolling mass follows behind them, catches their ankles and overtakes them. A dense tumble of cans piles around their legs and torsos.
At 4.7-6.7s, A gives one continuous frightened Japanese cry {わーーーー！}, voice timbre referencing @Audio 1.
At 5.0-7.0s, B joins with {わーーーー！}, voice timbre referencing @Audio 2. Keep the two voices distinct even while overlapping.
They lose their footing and sink into the heap; keep their faces visible.
By 8.5s, both are immobilized up to their shoulders, side by side. Their voices have stopped.

Progress from running to overtaking to burial; no running loop.
8.5-10.5s — SILENCE AFTER THE AVALANCHE
Front medium two-shot. A is on the left, B on the right. Both heads and their raised hands emerge from the SAME settled heap of cans.
The machine's output stops. A few final cans roll down the pile; the metallic roar quickly fades.
A holds her original unopened can just above the heap and stares in disbelief.
B takes ONE loose can from the pile. Bodies remain naturally concealed, with coherent shoulders and arms.
<The last few cans clatter and settle, then faint street ambience.>
10.5-12.5s — THE TINY OPENING SOUND
Cut to a medium close-up of B, her face and the can held just below her chin.
Still buried, B calmly opens the pull tab once with a brief hand movement and synchronized sound.
<One crisp can-opening click and a short "psst.">
The "psst" is escaping gas, not a vocalization.
B's mouth stays closed. She looks quietly satisfied and holds the open can. No speech, drinking sequence or additional action.
Keep the pile visible around her shoulders. No music or comedy sting.
12.5-15.0s — THE FAMILIAR FACE
Cut to A's face, with cans around her shoulders and her original unopened can still visible at the lower frame edge.
Her familiar stunned, uncomprehending expression: wide eyes, small pupils, raised eyebrows, slightly parted lips held still.
Her gaze shifts once from the single can to the mountain around her, then settles forward.
Use a short controlled push-in and hold the final full second. No dialogue, scream or repeated mouth movements.
End directly on A's silent face.

OUTPUT RULES
Only A's opening sentence and the TWO assigned sustained cries. Each uses her own voice reference. No additional dialogue, narration, laughter, improvised vocal reactions or voice from the vending machine.
No subtitles, captions, speech bubbles, readable text, logos, watermark, HUD or end card.
No extra people, duplicate characters, mixed identities, extra limbs, fused hands, costume changes, injuries or disappearing can pile.
Readable progression: purchase → overflow → escape → burial → tiny opening sound → stunned face. Each shot adds a development; no repetitive action loops.

Seedance 2.5 提示词
以所选画幅比例，创建一个全新的 15 秒日语动作喜剧短片，要求对白与音效同步。

【故事】
A 买了一罐汽水。自动贩卖机突然喷涌出数百个易拉罐。A 与 B 仓皇逃跑，却被翻滚而来的罐头雪崩追及，埋至肩部。B 从容地打开一罐。结尾落在 A 那张熟悉的惊愕脸上，手中仍握着她买的那唯一一罐。
【参考】
A = 来自 @Image 1 的黑发角色；音色来自 @Audio 1。
B = 来自 @Image 2 的白发角色；音色来自 @Audio 2。
须精确保留五官、发型、服装、配饰、身材比例与参考美术风格。参考仅定义身份与音色，而非姿势、背景或台词。不得融合身份，也不得回放已录制的词句。

【场景与风格】
黄昏时分的涩谷十字路口旁空旷人行道。一台与人等高的自动贩卖机置于画面右侧，其下方取货口朝向镜头。A 立于机器旁；B 在她左侧等候。付款已经完成。
涩谷建筑、十字路口斑马线、地面、机器、易拉罐与光照均为照片级真实质感。A 与 B 保持手绘二维动画风格，线条干净，使用赛璐璐上色，并融入接触阴影与反射光。
成排的普通饮料罐与选货按钮；不可出现可辨认的标签或标志。
【道具与动作连续性】
所有易拉罐均为手掌大小的金属圆筒，银色配青色色带与拉环。不得出现液体喷涌、泡沫、巨型罐体或无定形金属块。
每一只新出现的易拉罐都必须从同一个取货口涌出。机器保持原有尺寸与外观。
易拉罐以细窄的流束喷出，呈扇形散开，弹跳并滚落成地面雪崩，将二人吞没。
A 用右手接住第一只罐，并在最后一帧前始终紧握这只未开启的罐。她不得再次按下按钮。
仅限两名角色；二人均被埋住。须保持面部可见、身体无伤。各镜头之间须保留已堆积的罐堆。
【0.0–2.0 秒——只买一罐】
以中景双人镜头开场，呈现两位角色、选货按钮与取货口。
A 用左手按下其中一个按钮。在 0.2–1.1 秒期间，A 用日语说 {いっぽんだけ。}，音色参考 @Audio 1，嘴唇自然同步。
一只易拉罐以普通的“咣当”声落入出货托盘。A 用右手将其拿起。B 在一旁随意观看。
须在 2.0 秒前完成购买动作；不出现走近或投币过程。
（轻快、短促的日常器乐背景音乐。）
<按钮点击声，一只易拉罐的普通咣当声。>

【2.0–4.5 秒——机器停不下来】
保持清晰的三分之三角度视野，纳入机器、两位角色与地面。
A 刚取走她的罐，另一只即落下，随后接连掉落更多。咣当声逐渐加速，演变为急促的机械哒哒声。
至约 2.8 秒，一股持续的易拉罐流从取货口喷涌而出，呈扇形散开，在地面上化作翻滚的雪崩。
机器颤抖但保持直立。A 与 B 均有明显反应：双目睁大、双肩一缩，随后转身奔逃。
须直接呈现正常出货转为雪崩的过程，不得用切换或烟雾进行遮挡。
（急促流束开始时，背景音乐立即切断。）
<加速的金属咣当声、机械哒哒声、罐体倾泻声。>

【4.5–8.5 秒——逃跑无济于事】
侧面跟踪镜头。两位角色沿同一条人行道向画面左侧奔跑，远离机器。A 的右手仍紧握最初那只罐。
翻滚的罐堆紧随其后，缠住她们脚踝并将其吞没。密集翻滚的罐体堆积至她们的腿部和躯干周围。
在 4.7–6.7 秒期间，A 发出一声持续的日语惊叫 {わーーーー！}，音色参考 @Audio 1。
在 5.0–7.0 秒期间，B 加入一声 {わーーーー！}，音色参考 @Audio 2。即使声音重叠，也须保持两种音色彼此分明。
二人失去平衡，沉入罐堆之中；保持面部可见。
至 8.5 秒，二人并肩被埋至肩部，无法动弹。喊声停止。

须呈现由奔逃、被追上到被埋的递进过程；不得出现奔跑循环。
【8.5–10.5 秒——雪崩后的沉寂】
正面中景双人镜头。A 在左，B 在右。两人的头与举起的双手从同一堆已稳定的易拉罐中露出。
机器停止出货。几只最后的罐体沿罐堆滚落；金属轰鸣声迅速消退。
A 将最初那只未开启的罐举在罐堆上方，难以置信地凝视。
B 从罐堆中取出一只松散的罐。身体自然隐没于罐中，肩部与手臂保持连贯一致。
<最后几只易拉罐叮当作响并稳定下来，随后是隐约的街景环境音。>

【10.5–12.5 秒——那声轻微的开罐声】
切至 B 的中近景镜头，包含她的脸与举在下颌附近的易拉罐。
B 仍被埋住，以一个简短的手部动作从容地一次性拉开拉环，并配有同步音效。
<一声清脆的开罐“咔哒”声与一段短促的“嘶——”声。>
“嘶——”声为气体逸出的声音，而非人声。
B 双唇紧闭。她神情安静满足，并握着已开启的罐。不得出现台词、喝饮动作或其他附加行为。
须保持其肩部周围的罐堆可见。不得使用音乐或喜剧配乐音效。
【12.5–15.0 秒——那张熟悉的脸】
切至 A 的面部镜头，肩部四周环绕易拉罐，画面下沿边仍可见她最初那只未开启的罐。
呈现她标志性的、无法理解的惊愕神态：眼睛睁大、双眉上抬、瞳孔缩小、双唇轻启并保持不动。
她的视线由那只孤零零的罐移向周围的“罐山”一次，随后定格向前。
使用一次短促克制的推镜头，并保持最后一秒定格。不得有台词、尖叫或重复的嘴部动作。
画面直接结束在 A 沉默的脸上。

【输出规则】
仅可出现 A 的那句开场台词与两句指定的持续喊声。各角色使用其对应的音色参考。不得加入额外的台词、旁白、笑声、即兴的人声反应或来自自动贩卖机的声音。
不得出现字幕、说明文字、对话气泡、可辨认文字、标志、水印、HUD 及片尾画面。
不得出现额外人物、重复角色、身份混杂、多余肢体、手部融合、服装变化、受伤或消失的罐堆。
可读的剧情递进：购买 → 溢出 → 逃跑 → 埋住 → 轻微的开罐声 → 惊愕的脸。每个镜头都须带来新进展；不得出现重复的动作循环。

CORE CONCEPT

Transform the destination into a charming handcrafted miniature world made entirely from knitted yarn, soft felt, embroidery, and plush textile materials. Reimagine its architecture, streets, nature, transportation, and local atmosphere as a sophisticated collectible textile diorama.

LANDMARK & COMPOSITION

Build a complete miniature environment around it using authentic local architecture, streets, gardens, trees, shops, landscape, and a few tiny generic yarn characters. Every element should visibly feel handmade:
- chunky knitted yarn
- soft felt
- embroidered details
- woven fabric
- stitched edges
- wool fibers
- plush textile surfaces
- tiny handcrafted imperfections

Architectural travel poster × knitted miniature diorama × handmade textile art × plush yarn world × sophisticated editorial illustration.

Wêneyekî pir rastîn ku bi kameraya dîjîtal a biçûk a destpêka salên 2000an hatiye kişandin, 4:3 asoyî. Referansê tenê ji bo parastina rû û berdewamiya heman karaktera jin a xeyalî bikar bîne. Por bi laçikeke bi gulik nixumandî ku ber bi paş ve hatiye kişandin, çend çîpên por derketine. Cil: fistanekî kevneşopî yê qat bi qat bi rengên qehweyî yên axê û şerabî, hirmetkeke hirî ya çinî li ser, gorên hirî di nav pêlavên plastîk de, destên wê ji kar hişk û ziwa bûne, tevnek biçûk a darîn li ser çokên wê. Dîmen: Devê konekî reş ê ji mûyê bizinan li zozanekî Zagrosê di nîvroyê de, giyayê kesk, bizinek girêdayî, çaydankeke metal li ser pelên agir, şopên berfê li ser lûtkeyên li paş, kursiyeke plastîk, komek betanî. Kêliyeke nû ya xwezayî û nehatiye amadekirin: Ji jêr ve hatiye kişandin, wekî ku kesek li ser giya li ber wê rûniştibe, nêzî metreyekê dûr. Ew di nîvê gotinê de ye û bi kesekî re diaxive ku li milê çep, li derveyî çarçoveyê ye, bi destekî mekoka tevnê girtiye, bi destê din îşaretan dike, rûyê wê aram e, qermiçokeke biçûk di navbera birûyên wê de, çîpek por ketiye devê wê. Serê bizinê dikeve quncikê çarçoveyê. Kamera: Dîmena kameraya dîjîtal a biçûk a kevn, xelekên ronahiyê yên sivik li dora keviyan ji ber tûjkirina zêde, keviyên binefşî li ser kenara ezmanê ronî, gerdiya sensora biçûk, rengên tewş û bêcan, hinekî nermiya wêneyên wê serdemê yên ku tarîx li ser wan hatiye nivîsandin, bê flaş. Kompozîsyona rasthatî: çokên wê ji çarçoveyê hatine birîn, keviya kon ji jor ve wêneyê dibire, li jêrê pir zêde giya heye. Ronahî û pozlama: Ronahiya tûj a nîvroyê, ezman hinekî zêde ronî û spî bûye, siya kûr di hundirê kon de li paş wê, siyên xurt di bin çav û pozê wê de, hinarkên wê ji bayê sor bûne, toz û têlên hiriyê li ser qumaşê. Estetîk: Rastiya arşîva malbatê, wek wêneyekî ku li ser kartek bîrê ya kevn hatibe dîtin, germ û ne xemilandî. Çermê rastîn, destên rastîn, qumaşê rastîn. Bi tu awayî: cilaya kovara National Geographic, rengdana sînemayî, paşxaneya şêlû ya profesyonel, portreya destkariyê ya bi poz û amadekirî, rotûş û xemilandina çerm, rengên bi ronahiya berfireh a zêde, sîmetrî, tiştên ji bo dîmenê hatine danîn, an laşê bêkêmasî yê zekaya çêkirî tune be.

H&M — “NEW UNIFORM” I researched H&M’s current brand/visual system first. The strongest identifiable elements are H&M red + black/white, a bold fashion-led typographic system, dramatic in-the-moment photography, and H&M’s own type family. H&M’s published style guide specifically emphasizes dramatic contrast, captivating in-the-moment/action photography, while its typography system uses IBM Plex Sans for supporting copy and a condensed headline face for impact. H&M also maintains proprietary fonts including HMSans, HMSerif, HM Amperserif and HMMove. So unlike the MANGO direction, this should be more energetic, graphic, youthful and high-contrast rather than Mediterranean/minimal. ⸻ PROMPT — H&M “NEW UNIFORM” FORMAT Ultra-Premium H&M Fashion SMM Promotional Poster Vertical 4:5 Instagram Hero Creative Global Fashion Retail Campaign Contemporary Fashion Advertising Commercial Fashion Graphic Design Agency-Level Art Direction Behance Front Page Quality 8K UHD Hyper-Realistic Fashion × Graphic Design × Street Culture Fusion High-Impact Visual Communication Zero AI Slop Zero Generic Fast-Fashion Advertising Zero Catalogue Aesthetic Zero Luxury-Copycat Aesthetic ⸻ CORE STRATEGY This is not simply a clothing advertisement. This is H&M turned into a visual statement. The campaign should communicate: fashion moves fast. culture moves faster. H&M should feel: accessible + expressive + contemporary + youthful + global + confident. The visual language should combine: H&M fashion campaign × editorial magazine × street-culture poster × high-fashion graphic design × digital-first social advertising The result should feel unmistakably H&M, not Zara, Mango, COS or a generic luxury fashion brand. H&M’s own published style direction emphasizes dramatic contrast and in-the-moment photography, so the photography should feel alive rather than static. ⸻ CAMPAIGN IDEA “NEW UNIFORM” Forget traditional uniforms. This is: THE UNIFORM OF NOW. The clothes represent the constantly changing identity of a new generation. One day: minimal. Next day: street. Next: tailored. Next: experimental. H&M becomes the wardrobe that keeps up. The campaign message: THE UNIFORM CHANGES. But unlike the MANGO concept, the H&M typography should feel: bold compressed graphic energetic slightly disruptive The giant H&M lettering can be: partially cropped, stacked, repeated, layered, hidden behind the model, intersected by red graphic blocks, cut by diagonal photographic frames, and pushed beyond the canvas. The typography should feel like a physical poster installation, not simple text. ⸻ HERO SUBJECT Young female fashion model. Contemporary global fashion appearance. Natural skin texture. Strong expressive face. Minimal but polished makeup. Confident expression. No artificial influencer smile. No exaggerated luxury pose. The model should feel like someone who actually belongs in the city. Youthful. Self-assured. Energetic. Culturally aware. ⸻ WARDROBE Create a contemporary H&M fashion look. HERO LOOK Oversized black leather-effect bomber jacket. Crisp white fitted tank. Relaxed wide-leg grey trousers. Chunky black footwear. Small silver jewelry. Structured mini shoulder bag. Subtle red accessory detail. Layered styling. The clothing should feel: accessible fashion elevated through styling. Not couture. Not runway costume. Not quiet luxury. Not excessive branding. The clothes should look genuinely wearable. ⸻ POSE / MOVEMENT The model is captured mid-stride. One foot forward. Jacket moving naturally. Hair slightly moving. Body turned approximately 15 degrees. Direct eye contact. One hand adjusting the jacket. Other hand relaxed. The image should feel like a moment captured rather than a pose performed. Underneath: THE NEW EVERYDAY This becomes the campaign’s visual signature. The red block should feel almost like a piece of Swiss graphic design translated into contemporary fashion advertising. ⸻ PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE High-energy fashion photography. Dramatic contrast. Sharp moment. Natural movement. Hard directional light. Deep shadows. Bright whites. Saturated H&M red. Natural skin. Realistic fabric. Subtle motion in clothing. H&M’s published style guide specifically calls for dramatic contrast and captivating in-the-moment imagery, with action shots as the primary photographic direction. ⸻ LIGHTING Large directional studio source. Strong side lighting. Controlled hard shadows. Bright white highlights. Deep black clothing separation. Red surfaces receiving rich saturated light. Natural skin exposure. No beauty-dish glamour. No soft luxury haze. No excessive bloom. No artificial neon. ⸻ CAMERA ARRI Alexa Mini LF 50mm fashion/editorial lens Slightly low camera angle. Full-body composition. Fast-fashion campaign energy. Moderate depth of field. Extremely sharp clothing texture. Natural movement. High dynamic range. Premium commercial fashion photography. ⸻ POST-PRODUCTION Contemporary global fashion campaign grading. Clean whites. Deep blacks. Highly saturated controlled red. Natural skin tones. Subtle film grain. Visible textile texture. Crisp typography. Sharp graphic edges. Controlled contrast. No excessive retouching. No plastic skin. No artificial HDR. No fake luxury glow. No cinematic teal-orange grade. No excessive grain. ⸻ BRAND SAFETY / CONSISTENCY The final visual must immediately read as: H&M without relying solely on the logo. Brand recognition should come from: red / black / white bold condensed typography dramatic in-motion photography accessible contemporary styling graphic campaign language youthful global fashion energy strong commercial communication Do not make it resemble: ZARA’s restrained editorial minimalism. MANGO’s Mediterranean warmth. COS’s architectural minimalism. Prada’s intellectual luxury. Louis Vuitton’s heritage luxury. The visual identity must remain H&M. ⸻ FINAL FEEL If: H&M × a global fashion magazine × a contemporary graphic design studio × street culture × a giant urban billboard created one campaign together. Not a catalogue. Not a generic fast-fashion ad. Not a luxury fashion imitation. Not a simple red-and-white poster. A high-impact H&M campaign where typography, movement, fashion and graphic design become one visual system. COMPOSITION
Divide the poster into two perfectly equal horizontal halves with no gap.

TOP HALF — CINEMATIC PHOTOGRAPH
Create a wide horizontal, photorealistic travel photograph representing [COUNTRY / CITY / LOCATION / SUBJECT]. Automatically choose the most meaningful subject, architecture, landscape, or moment associated with the destination.

The image must feel like an authentic editorial photograph: natural perspective, realistic lighting, subtle color grading, strong central subject, cinematic atmosphere, and believable environmental details.

BOTTOM HALF — OPEN-BOOK JOURNAL
Create one fully opened horizontal hardcover photography book centered in the lower half, viewed almost from above with slight realistic perspective.

The book should occupy roughly 86% of the lower-half width. The spine must sit exactly in the center, with perfectly equal left and right pages. Show realistic paper edges, thickness, spine curvature, soft shadows, and premium tactile paper.

LEFT PAGE
Fill the entire left page with one dominant color naturally extracted from the destination’s visual identity.

Place a smaller horizontal landscape photograph at the center of the page, showing the same destination or subject from the upper scene. Keep it rectangular, clean, and surrounded by an even generous border.

RIGHT PAGE
Use warm ivory paper with abundant negative space.

Below it, place ONE perfectly upright vintage vertical postage stamp. Give it a cream perforated border, subtle paper texture, and a delicate shadow.

Inside the stamp, do not simply reproduce the main photograph. Instead, reinterpret 2–4 recognizable elements from the destination as a playful editorial illustration using bold hand-drawn black outlines, simplified shapes, and ONE bright accent color drawn from the scene.

Below the stamp, add two short centered lines of gentle poetic English text.

BACKGROUND
Outside the open book, create a softly blurred continuation of the destination’s environment. Preserve only its general colors, light, and atmosphere while keeping individual objects indistinct.

STYLE
Cinematic travel photography × contemporary photography monograph × open-book visual diary × vintage postage illustration × minimalist editorial design.

Warm, quiet, sophisticated, tactile, intimate, and collectible.

Perfect 50/50 top-bottom division → perfectly centered book spine → equal pages → strong horizontal photography → intact upright stamp → generous negative space.

Avoid portrait-oriented photo panels, blurred side bars, stretched imagery, invented landmarks, distorted architecture, uneven pages, tilted or cropped books, multiple stamps, excessive decoration, clutter, logos, watermarks, UI elements, or unnecessary typography.

FORMAT
3:4 vertical, two equal halves, premium editorial photography, realistic open-book construction, refined typography, cohesive travel-journal aesthetic.
